name: Contextual AI
description: Build enterprise RAG agents that answer from your documents with citations, and query them through a REST API, SDKs or a hosted MCP server, for teams with large knowledge bases.

skills.name: Query Agent
skills.description: Queries a Contextual AI agent with a question and returns an answer grounded in your documents, with citations and attributions.

skills.name: Build RAG Agent
skills.description: Creates a datastore, ingests your documents into it and builds a specialized RAG agent on top, through the API or the GUI.

skills.name: Parse Documents
skills.description: Parses documents into structured text ready for retrieval with Contextual AI's Parse component, through the API.

skills.name: Rerank Results
skills.description: Reranks retrieved passages by their relevance to a query with Contextual AI's Rerank component, through the API.

skills.name: Evaluate Responses
skills.description: Scores model responses against natural-language unit tests with LMUnit to measure answer quality.
